description:
Public EV charging sites per suburb, DC fast-charger counts, and the distance to the nearest fast charger, Australia-wide.

Coverage: Australia-wide, every suburb. DC fast sites are well covered; slower AC and unrated sites are partially mapped. Current to 2026-10-27. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/ev-chargers`.

**Price: 3¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: charging_sites_total, dc_fast_sites, dc_ultra_fast_sites, other_charging_sites, dc_fast_sites_within_10km, nearest_dc_fast_charger_m. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_transport_ev_chargers
title: Suburb · Electric vehicle charging
